import nanosurf

# Initialise the AFM controller
spm = nanosurf.SPM()          # or nanosurf.C3000(), nanosurf.CX(), etc.

scan = app.Scan
zctrl = app.ZController

zctrl.IGain = 6000    # Integral gain
